the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: T is profinite as a topological space; a quasi-compact open W containing f(T) is made G^0-invariant; the closed map T -> pi_0(W) and the profinite clopen refinement produce finitely many affine opens U_xi whose preimages cover T, giving an affine U_0 containing f(T) per component; each component Z meeting f(T) has a rational point and is a translate of G^0, so after translation the problem reduces to G = G^0 irreducible with an affine neighbourhood U of e; the open immersion U x_k T -> G x_k T has an image that is a finite union of boxes because |U x_k T| = |U| x |T|, hence only finitely many translates U f(t)^{-1} occur, and since G is irreducible their intersection is nonempty and contains a k-rational point g, giving f(T) subset g^{-1}U (source lines 1316-1401)
